drafts.name: NovaAir family seating

match.pattern: together|adjacent|next to each other|side by side|famil

drafts.summary: Add a seat-party composition that finds ranked blocks of three, applies all assignments atomically, exposes it through a flight-scoped API, and adds a family-seat chooser to the existing seat map. Update the API and help copy that currently describe seat changes as single-passenger only.
acceptance_criteria: On the seat selection page for the three-person demo booking, a user can request seats together and see available three-seat blocks.
Every offered block is consecutive in one row and on one side of the aisle, excludes unavailable seats, and satisfies the passengers' child and exit-row restrictions.
Search results show total extra cost and are ordered from lowest to highest cost; the seeded free option 21A, 21B and 21C appears first.
Selecting an offered block stages one seat for each of the three passengers and shows the choices in the existing seat map and transaction details.
Confirming a party option assigns all three passengers through the party API; if any assignment cannot be completed, every passenger keeps their previous seat.
Manual single-passenger seat selection continues to work.
The API documentation and help center describe the three-seats-together capability and no longer claim that families can only be moved one passenger at a time.
The existing seat-party contract tests run against the exported capability and pass.
